author: Reilly Mahon
title: Arraignment scheduled for man charged with attempted murder in Sioux City - NewsBreak
text:
By Reilly Mahon Maren Ewertz ,
12 hours ago
SIOUX CITY , Iowa ( KCAU ) — The man accused of shooting a woman in broad daylight in Sioux City is set to have his arraignment.
Court documents indicate that Anthony Hayes Jr., 30, is set to appear in court on April 24. He is charged with attempted murder.
Back on April 8, officers responded to a shooting in the area of the 3200 block South Lakeport Street.
Story continues below
Authorities said a woman was found with multiple gunshot wounds and taken to a local hospital with life-threatening injuries.
Police took Hayes Jr. into custody a short time later. He is still in the Woodbury County Jail on a $500,000 bond.
